found_at: https://stackoverflow.design/brand/logo (Stack Overflow's Stacks design system, Brand > Logo: the Symbol shown on its #FF5E00 field)
edits: kept both elements as published: the #FF5E00 field (element 0) and the #201C1D symbol (element 1)

viewBox set to a square around the symbol (266.259 11.090 433.009 433.009, from `svgtool crop --square --pad 0.29` on the symbol alone), so the field becomes the app icon's square tile with the symbol at the app icon's proportion (63% of the tile height, as in apple-touch-icon.png)
notes: One file for both themes: the brand's own app-icon tile (rule 2b), as the stack alone is Off-Black and the orange is the brand's. Alternative if you'd rather not have a tile: stackoverflow.co/favicon.svg, the bare stack in #FF5E00 (downloads/stack-exchange/src10/so-co-favicon.svg), reads on both themes too; that is Stack Overflow's company favicon rather than stackexchange.com's.
